taha.definition: n. The African rufous-necked weaver bird (Hyphantornis texor).

tahina.translation: n. （中东地区调味用的）芝麻酱

tahini.definition: n. a thick Middle Eastern paste made from ground sesame seeds
tahini.translation: n. (中东地区调味用的)芝麻酱

tahir.translation: 塔希尔（阿尔古万的旧称）

tahiti.definition: n. an island in the south Pacific; the most important island in French Polynesia; made famous by Robert Louis Stevenson and Paul Gauguin
tahiti.translation: n. 塔希提岛（位于南太平洋, 法属波利西亚的经济活动中心）

tahitian.definition:
n. a native or inhabitant of Tahiti
n. the Oceanic language spoken on Tahiti
a. of or relating to or characteristic of the island of Tahiti or its residents or their language and culture
tahitian.translation: 塔希提岛的, 塔希提人的, 塔希提语的, 塔希提人(尤指该岛的波利尼西亚人)

tahitians.definition:
plural of Tahitian
n. a native or inhabitant of Tahiti
n. the Oceanic language spoken on Tahiti
a. of or relating to or characteristic of the island of Tahiti or its residents or their language and culture
tahitians.translation: (Tahitian 的复数) 塔希提岛的, 塔希提人的, 塔希提语的, 塔希提人(尤指该岛的波利尼西亚人)

tahoma.translation: n. 大河马字体；加速度很快的私家车, 前面有突出的护架

tahr.translation: n. [动](喜马拉雅山等地产的)塔尔羊(有弯角,长粗毛)

tahsil.translation: n. 区(印度行政区名称,税收区划单位)

tahsildar.translation: n. (印度税区的)税务员,收税人

tahur.translation: 达干尔族, 达干尔族人
